Inglewood, California
  April 7, 2020

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on Tuesday,
  April 7, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Housing Authority at the hour of 2:22 p.m.
  The City Clerk/Housing Authority Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as
  follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Housing Authority Chairman Butts/Council
  Members/Housing Authority Members Padilla, and
  Franklin; and
  Absent:  Council Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson,
  and Morales.
  City/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Housing Authority

131.8  SALE OF PROPERTY LOCATED AT 3500 WEST MANCHESTER
  BOULEVARD #354 APPROVED – FIRST TIME HOMEBUYER PROGRAM TO
  QIANA RENDINE. Staff report dated April 7, 2020, was presented recommending
  approval of a sale of property located at 3500 West Manchester Boulevard #354,
  Inglewood, CA 90305 (the “Property”) pursuant to a hybrid sale under the first Time
  Homebuyer Program to Qiana Rendine.

  It was moved by Mayor Butts, and seconded by Council Member Padilla that the City
  Council does hereby: 1) Approve the sale of property in the amount of $312,500; 2)
  Authorize an advance of funds for down payment assistance in the amount of $62,500 in
  order to meet the closing deadline; and 3) Authorize the Mayor to execute and deliver all
  documents to implement the sales transaction. The motion was carried by the following
  roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Franklin, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Members Dotson, and Morales.
  It was moved by Housing Authority Chairman Butts, and seconded by Housing Authority
  Member Padilla that the Housing Authority does hereby: 1) Approve the sale of the
  property to Ms. Rendine; 2) Authorize the Housing Authority Chairman to execute and
  deliver all documents to implement the sales transaction; and 3) Approve reimbursement
  to the General Fund for said advances necessary to consummate the sale transaction. The
  motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Housing Authority Members Padilla, Franklin, and Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Housing Authority Members Dotson, and Morales.
  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned at the hour of 2:26 p.m.

  Approved this ________ day of ____________, 2020

  _________________________
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
